summary: Anti-pattern reference board for Index v1. It explicitly documents rejected designs, roles, props, materials, proportions, and behavior drifts that must not be replicated.

layout: Landscape warning/reference board with cream panels, red rejection headers, red X overlays, and a dark green footer.
Top title reads INDEX v1 — ANTI-PATTERNS / DO NOT REPLICATE.
Multiple numbered sections show wrong Index interpretations with red strike-through marks.
Bottom strip gives Index identity at a glance with small approved cue icons.
main_rejection: Large left panel rejects human librarian / archivist drift.
Rejected example shows a realistic human archivist/librarian in glasses holding books in a library-like setting.
Panel notes this is too human, real-world librarian/archive read, not an autonomous agent, wrong ontology, wrong face, wrong scale.
wrong_turnaround_variants: Human archivist drift: human-like woman with glasses and clipboard/book, crossed out.
Elderly librarian drift: older human librarian styling with grey hair and skirt, crossed out.
Generic robot drift: small chrome/white robot with antennae and screen face, crossed out.
Patch clone drift: teal hoodie/antenna character resembling Patch, crossed out.
wrong_actions_roles: Desk-bound Klause drift: Index at computers/dashboard, rejected as parser-trail/desk decision work.
Legal/Writ drift: records and assent/legal authority imagery, rejected as wrong jurisdiction.
Magic library drift: glowing purple magical archive with candles/runes, rejected as wrong genre.
Cute helper/mascot drift: waving, hearts, over-cute behavior, rejected as losing provenance role.
Paperwork storm drift: character swallowed by flying papers, rejected as evidence consuming the character.
Sad downcast drift: looking down as sadness, rejected because looking down should indicate attention.
Explorer/field drift: expedition scarf/bag energy, rejected as wrong role.
wrong_kit_props: Human eyes with irises, pupils, catches, lashes.
wrong_scale_relationships: Too tall / human scale reads too human.
Too small / toy scale loses presence.
Patch clone / two antennae gives wrong silhouette, colour, and gear.
Generic robot scale is not autonomous-agent identity.
Correct scale is compact Patch-level autonomous agent, not human-sized and not Bit/Bot simplification.
hard_nos: No human woman, child, or exposed human face.
No Patch teal hoodie, two antennae, crossbody terminal bag, or teal trainers.
No literal glasses or removable eyewear.
No human eyes, irises, pupils, catches, lashes, or glossy wet-eye rendering.
No sad/worried/downcast emotion as substitute for attention direction.
No Writ seals, assent language, legal authority, gavels, courtrooms, legal ledgers.
No Klause desk/dashboard/office decision role/stamp workflow posture.
No paperwork storm that swallows the character.
No robe/cloak/scarf/shawl/sporty hoodie/tactical hood/cowl replacing the slouchy hooded cardigan.
No bright toy colors or plastic feel.
text_visible: INDEX v1 — ANTI-PATTERNS / DO NOT REPLICATE
DO NOT REPLICATE THESE DESIGNS, POSES, PROPS, PROPORTIONS OR TREATMENTS. THESE BREAK INDEX’S ONTOLOGY AND VISUAL IDENTITY.
DO NOT MAKE INDEX HUMAN, ELDERLY, A GENERIC ROBOT, OR A PATCH RECOLOR.
INDEX PRINCIPLE: SOURCE FIRST. FOLLOW THE PAPER TRAIL. PRESERVE CONTEXT. REPORT WHAT IS, NOT WHAT SHOULD BE.

positive_constraints: Use this sheet primarily as negative guidance and QA rejection criteria.
Keep Index autonomous-agent ontology, not human or robot archetype.
Keep source-evidence identity: paper trail, records, provenance, careful retrieval.
Use the approved style sheet and approved hero for positive visual design; use this sheet to prevent drift.
Treat looking down as attentive source review when shown in valid contexts.
negative_constraints: Do not replicate any crossed-out design, pose, prop set, color palette, scale, or role drift shown on this board.
Do not make Index human, elderly, generic robot, Patch recolor, explorer, lawyer, magical librarian, desk clerk, cute helper, or sad mascot.

Do not use human facial anatomy, glasses, teal hoodie, terminal bag, legal props, dashboards, magic props, field gear, pink doll colors, chrome robot materials, black stealth styling, or sterile office blue/white.

best_for: Differentiating Index from Patch, Bit/Bot, Writ, Klause, and generic human librarian imagery.
not_sufficient_for: Positive generation by itself; pair with approved hero/style sheet.
Detailed final outfit rendering without the approved style sheet.
Treating any rejected example as a fallback design.
